raw.description:
As a Strategic Account Manager – Multi-Family, you will help grow Moen's Multi-Family business by building strategic partnerships with leading ownership groups, management companies, general contractors, and preferred distribution partners across the apartment, student housing, senior living, military housing, and single-family rental markets. You'll strengthen existing partnerships while identifying new opportunities to increase product specifications, expand market share, and position Moen solutions within high-profile new construction, renovation, and replacement projects.

In this collaborative, customer-focused role, you'll serve as a trusted strategic partner to some of the industry's most recognized organizations. Working closely with internal sales teams, channel partners, marketing, and product leadership, you'll help shape national Multi-Family growth strategies, influence key project decisions from specification through completion, and create long-term value for both Moen and our customers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys developing executive-level relationships, navigating complex sales cycles, and collaborating across multiple teams to achieve shared goals. You'll combine strategic thinking with strong project management skills to identify growth opportunities, build trusted relationships with executive-level decision makers, and help strengthen Moen's long-term position within the Multi-Family market.

We value individuals who can Think Fast by identifying opportunities and solving customer challenges; Work It Together by building trusted partnerships across teams and customers; and Make the Hard Call by making thoughtful decisions that create long-term value.

POSITION LOCATION: Candidates located within the Central or Western United States are preferred, with a preference for those based near Chicago, Atlanta, Washington, DC, the San Francisco Bay Area, Houston, or San Antonio, TX. Candidates should also have convenient access to a major airport to effectively support customer engagement and travel requirements. Internal FBIN candidates outside of these preferred markets are encouraged to apply.

This role requires up to 70% travel, including approximately 3 to 4 overnight trips per month. A company expense card is provided for approved travel-related expenses.

What you will be doing

  • Build, strengthen, and expand strategic relationships with leading ownership groups, management companies, general contractors, and preferred distribution partners across the Multi-Family market.
  • Increase product specifications and expand market share by promoting Moen's portfolio of solutions across targeted ownership groups, strategic accounts, and key project opportunities.
  • Support the development and execution of strategic growth plans for assigned national accounts by identifying emerging opportunities, expanding customer relationships, and increasing Moen's presence across the Multi-Family market.
  • Guide high-profile new construction, renovation, and replacement projects from specification through completion, partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Channel Marketing, and Sales leadership to help shape strategic initiatives that support long-term Multi-Family growth.
  • Collaborate with regional sales teams, Business Development Managers, and National Sales leaders to advance Multi-Family opportunities and increase project conversion.
  • Partner with the field sales organization by sharing best practices, project opportunities, and customer strategies that help increase project conversion and strengthen customer relationships.
  • Represent Moen at industry trade shows, Multi-Family conferences, networking events, and customer meetings to strengthen relationships and cultivate new opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer insights, and industry developments while providing insights and recommendations that help inform future business strategies.
  • Utilize travel, promotional, and business development budgets responsibly to maximize customer engagement and return on investment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience with a demonstrated track record of achieving business objectives and building strategic customer relationships.
  • Experience managing national or regional strategic accounts within the Multi-Family, commercial construction, building products, or related industries.
  • Experience developing long-term strategic partnerships that create mutual business value and customer growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Strong relationship-building, networking, and communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and a consultative approach to customer engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM platforms.
  • Ability to travel up to 70%, including approximately 3 to 4 overnight trips per month.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience working within the Multi-Family industry, including apartment, student housing, senior living, military housing, single-family rental, or related commercial construction segments.
  • Experience selling plumbing, kitchen and bath, building materials, or other specification-driven commercial products.
  • Experience collaborating with architects, designers, ownership groups, distributors, general contractors, or commercial construction professionals.
  • Knowledge of specification processes and commercial construction project cycles.
  • Experience leading strategic customer initiatives or serving as a trusted advisor to national Multi-Family organizations.

Fortune Brands believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is Hiring Pay Range: $90,000 USD - $130,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based sales incentive plan.

At Fortune Brands, we support the overall health and wellness of our associates by offering comprehensive, competitive benefits that prioritize all aspects of wellbeing and provide flexibility for our teammates’ unique needs. This includes robust health plans, a market-leading 401(k) program with a company contribution, product discounts, flexible time off benefits, adoption benefits, and more. We offer numerous ERGs (Employee Resource Groups) to foster a sense of belonging for all associates.

Fortune Brands is built on industry-leading brands and innovation within the high-growth categories of water, outdoors and security. The Company makes innovative products for residential and commercial environments, with a growing focus on digital solutions and products that add luxury, contribute to safety and enhance sustainability. To learn more, visit our website at .

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Engineer is responsible for independently designing and modifying power system protection and automation schemes, preparing engineering documentation, and supporting commissioning activities. This role requires professional judgment, technical expertise, and the ability to work on multiple projects with moderate supervision.

POSITION DETAILS

Job Title:

Engineer – Substation

Reports To:

Engineering Manager

Location:

Hybrid / Remote

FLSA Status

: Full-Time, Exempt

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Design substation protection schemes and specify relays for use in redundant protection systems.
  • Prepare and review engineering drawings, specifications, and calculations.
  • Perform protective relay coordination studies and program substation relays.
  • Conduct short-circuits analysis and develops relay settings for electromechanical and microprocessor relays.
  • Provide technical guidance to contractors, clients, and other engineers.
  • Assist with commissioning of new equipment and troubleshoot existing facilities.
  • Analyze fault events and prepare sequence-of-events reports.
  • Ensure all designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and company procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 2 years of electric utility or power engineering experience performing engineering calculations and design work.

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Proficiency in CAD and electrical modeling software.

The Senior Customer Care Representative is primarily responsible for answering in-bound calls from customers wishing to place orders, inquire about an order, or resolve an issue for a single line of business at Sarnova. This position requires an individual who demonstrates care and empathy, a focus on results, and strong communication skills in working across many departments on behalf of the customer. The Senior Customer Care Representative will be cross trained across multiple business units within the organization.

Organizational Impact:

In this role for Sarnova, you are our brand ambassador delivering delight in every interaction. You help deliver the right product, in the right hands, and in the right amount of time. You impact your line of business through empathy, order quality, first call resolution and promoting satisfied customers leading to growth, retention and advocacy.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Order Processing: Handle inbound calls and process orders through multiple channels, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in each transaction
  • Order Confirmation: Send order confirmations via email and provide customers with status updates and follow-ups to keep them informed throughout the order process
  • Order Accuracy: Review all orders for accuracy, make necessary adjustments to existing orders, and ensure orders are processed to fulfillment without delay
  • Special Orders Handling: Route special orders using the appropriate process and provide pricing information upon request
  • Customer Collaboration: Work closely with internal departments to address customer inquiries and act as a liaison to ensure customer needs are met
  • Product and Service Explanation: Learn and understand new products across a single product line to explain basic products and services to customers to aid in their purchasing decisions
  • Issue Resolution: Research and resolve billing and pricing inquiries, addressing customer concerns to ensure satisfaction and smooth order processing
  • Problem Solving: Resolve any order issues that prevent same-day shipping, and determine or authorize credits, rebills, and product returns when necessary
  • Administrative Support: Perform filing and other administrative tasks as needed
  • Additional job duties as assigned

Skills/Experience Required:

  • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Two to three years of customer service experience; experience should include an environment where calls were monitored and scored as well as metrics applied to individual and team performance
  • Strong computer skills; basic understanding of MS Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; must be able to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships with customers and co-workers
  • Ability to deal calmly and effectively with situations via telephone while maintaining and promoting a positive company image

Storytelling & Editorial Volunteer

Freedom Challenge USA
Part-Time (5 Hours/Week) | Volunteer Role, minimum 6 months

Do you have a heart for storytelling and a sharp eye for detail? Join Freedom Challenge USA as a Storytelling & Editorial Volunteer and help bring powerful global testimonies to life—supporting a movement that advocates for freedom from human trafficking through prayer, worship, and action.

This opportunity is ideal for someone looking to grow professionally, build a strong writing and editing portfolio, and develop marketable skills in nonprofit storytelling, cross-cultural communication, and digital publishing.

The Freedom Challenge is a movement of passionate women dedicated to freeing oppressed and enslaved women and children worldwide. We do this by praying intentionally and participating in physical challenges while raising funds and awareness to disrupt the cycles of oppression and poverty that can lead to human trafficking.

Role Overview

The Storytelling & Editorial Volunteer will refresh and repurpose testimonies received from Freedom Challenge projects around the world. These stories reflect how grant funding is transforming lives and communities. You’ll edit and publish them to our blog (through Squarespace), archive them for future marketing use, and collaborate with our team to ensure each story is handled with care, accuracy, and cultural sensitivity.

Responsibilities

  • Edit and rewrite global project testimonies
  • Ensure stories align with Freedom Challenge’s voice, tone, and values
  • Source appropriate visuals from our internal photo bank when needed
  • Publish stories to our blog (through Squarespace) with relevant formatting and imagery
  • Archive stories for future use in donor engagement, social media, and brochures
  • Collaborate with the Field Relation Specialist to retrieve fresh stories
  • Participate in training on cultural sensitivity and privacy protocols
  • Provide proofreading support for other content as needed
  • Report to the Content & Brand Lead and contribute to content planning

What You’ll Gain

  • Experience in cross-cultural storytelling and ethical editing
  • Skills in content creation, blog publishing, and digital archiving
  • Exposure to faith-based nonprofit communications and global missions
  • Development of professional writing, editing, and collaboration skills
  • A portfolio of meaningful work to showcase on your resume

Qualifications

  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills
  • Background or interest in Communications, Journalism, International Studies, or related fields
  • Sensitivity to cultural nuances and storytelling ethics
  • Familiarity with Squarespace or willingness to learn
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and respectful of privacy and confidentiality
  • A posture of learning, growth, and curiosity
  • Agreement with OM USA’s Statement of Faith
